info.name: ITSM Helpdesk API (G04)
info.description:
G04 - Postman API test collection for the local ITSM helpdesk backend. It covers every route mounted in backend/app/main.py (health, auth, users, categories, tickets, ticket attachments, notifications, and audit logs) and follows docs/API_CONTRACT.md, the agreed source of truth for request fields, response fields, and error codes.

How to use it: start the backend at http://localhost:8000, run 'alembic upgrade head' and the D08 demo seed ('python -m app.seed_demo'), then run the folders in order. Each login request writes accessToken and refreshToken, and each create request writes the id (categoryId, ticketId, secondTicketId, userId, attachmentId, notificationId) that later requests use. The demo password variables must be set to the password you typed for the D08 seed; no password is stored in the repository.

The two attachment requests need a local file chosen in the form field named 'file' (05.1 an allowed type, 08.9 a disallowed type).

Planned but unimplemented routes are deliberately absent because backend/app/api/v1/ does not mount them: articles, dashboard, reports, settings, and the React-only rows.

item.name: 00 Health
item.description: G04 - collection smoke test. GET /health is the one route that needs no token, so it proves the API and PostgreSQL are up before anything else runs.

item.name: 00.1 GET /health - the API and its database are up

request.description: Proves the FastAPI app answers and can reach PostgreSQL. A 503 with {'status': 'degraded'} means the database is down, so later folders would fail for that reason rather than from a bad request.

exec: pm.test('200 and both dependencies ok', function () {
